description: Exact prices for a set of SKUs and quantities, as the Standard Blanks cart would charge them: each line's unit price (set by its style's total units), the merchandise subtotal, shipping, and the total before tax. Pass ship_to_zip for that ZIP's shipping and estimated delivery dates (estimates, not guarantees); add need_by (YYYY-MM-DD) with it to learn whether the order is estimated to arrive by that date, and which lines would miss it; without a ZIP, shipping assumes a contiguous-US address and no dates are given. Sales tax is calculated at checkout. Creates nothing.

sku.description: A variant SKU from get_product (called with a color).

need_by.description: Date the order is needed by, YYYY-MM-DD. Answered only with ship_to_zip.

name: quote
title: Price a set of items
